label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Hi everyone,

I know many of you have been calling and texting, and I'm sorry my phone won't stop ringing! So here is the whole story in one place.

Around 2 a.m. on Sunday, November 8, a car drove through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd. Yes, through the window! Nobody was inside, and the driver is okay. The police came, and her insurance will pay for the damage. God protected us. I cried a little that morning, but now I am okay, I promise.

The car stopped exactly at my pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa day. My daughter says she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. My husband says the floor now looks like a rainbow threw up, so the shop is finally modern art. I am trying to see the funny side!

The front glass and one pedicure chair are gone. The city inspector must check the wall before we open. The contractor says we can reopen Monday, November 16.

Your gift cards are still good, and nobody lost any money.

This week, Trang, Kim, and I are working at my cousin Hoa's salon, Pearland Nail Bar. If you need nails, call or text my cell at 832-555-0147, and I will tell you when and where to come.

Thank you so much for all the texts, calls, and food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, and it was so good I almost cried again, this time from happy! Thank you for loving me and my shop.

See you soon,

[Your name]
Lotus Glow Nails
